entry.title: Nosy Alañaña Light
entry.note: Exact-QID lighthouse node fixes island position, replacing the older point about7m north. Octagonal facade direction and entry toward the southern keeper compound are photograph/site-layout reconstructions; no surveyed entrance bearing is claimed. Terrain supplies island ground contact. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
